items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: I wanted to have Anderson on trumpet... And, uh, beginning Tomorrow Night with Smitty on piano... I forgot about the name of, Ramsey. Oh, Lindsey Ramsey, yeah. Yeah. He was playing piano.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. I wanted to ask you about some of the people that have played with you at the Harmony Inn. I know a lot of them have been down there from time to time. Mm-hmm. Who were some of the musicians that have been down there? Nowadays or before? Well, we talked about, let's see, well, nowadays. Who's with you right now?

I wanted to have Anderson on trumpet. Mm-hmm. And Big Art drums. And, uh, beginning Tomorrow Night with Smitty on piano. So. Before then, we'd have such men as, uh, as, uh, Willie Paiju, a trumpet. Edgar Smith on drums. And, uh, I forgot about the name of, Ramsey. Oh, Lindsey Ramsey, yeah. Yeah. He was playing piano. Mm-hmm. What happened to him? Well, he decided to quit. I guess he, as, uh, immediately said he had what? In the mouth?
Maybe he said he got corroded. His mouth was all corroded.
